scope: Necessary cost-model allowance for the ENTIRE warm accepted solve with the recorded selected full setup, zero additional construction/acquisition/inference and no offline training cost. It is not proposal-only budget, an achievable bound, or evidence for learned superiority. Original five gate already failed; all accepted ten strengthen subsequent same-case denominator. No new control was confirmed across16media. The per-case minimum is a benchmark comparison envelope, not a deployed free algorithm chooser. Timing is exploratory and includes recorded first-use/order effects; no matched process-cold claim.
formula: allowance=min(0.9*mean(min eligible classical Q1 per case)-mean(candidate setup),0.9*mean(min eligible classical warm per case)); future setup/inference/acquisition lowers this allowance.
